scope: Exact Git snapshot; disposable build workspace and explicitly mocked UI APIs.

gates.name: category-ui-mocked
gates.details: The combined create-then-edit scenario remained race-prone: the edit control click returned, but the dialog was closed before the checkbox became visible.

remediation: Split UI creation and edit into isolated tests; seed the edit test with a preexisting category so async create invalidation cannot close the edit dialog.
